items.reason: Gap 1 describes a retry overlapping the first handler, passing the check before insertion, and processing the event twice.
Gap 0 explicitly identifies X-Event-Id as unsigned and explains that forging or varying it lets the same signed event bypass deduplication.
Gap 2 states that the provider sends charge.refunded while the map registers refund.created, so refunds never reach a handler.
None of the gaps depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
